patch_description: The current coordinate-descent can only move points along 4 orientation axes (8 directions). Known good Heilbronn configurations for n=13 are irregular, so the descent gets stuck in ring-symmetric local optima. Two targeted changes: (1) extend the direction set to 16 directions at 22.5° increments, allowing the search to break the initial 12-fold symmetry; (2) run the refinement from multiple deterministic initializations (circle+center, slightly perturbed circle with fixed seed, and a jittered grid), keeping the best result. This is cheap and improves the chance of finding a configuration beating the normalized benchmark.
